It has been decided to delete the following criteria for considering the scheduled urban co-operative banks as strong.","rationale":"DOC-f73ea1 and DOC-e6316c amend/supplement the base permission in DOC-709c7d and should be folded together."},{"primitive":"RESOLVE_CROSS_REFERENCE","doc_ids":["DOC-e6316c","DOC-709c7d"],"evidence_quote":"Please refer to our circular UBD. No. DOC-709c7d dated May 17, 2003 , permitting non-scheduled urban co-operative banks (UCBs) to place deposits with eligible scheduled urban co-operative banks.","rationale":"Cross-reference to DOC-709c7d should be replaced by the consolidated text."},{"primitive":"RESOLVE_CROSS_REFERENCE","doc_ids":["DOC-f73ea1","DOC-709c7d"],"evidence_quote":"Please refer to para 1(a) of our circular UBD No. DOC-709c7d dated May 17, 2003 on the captioned subject.","rationale":"Cross-reference to DOC-709c7d should be resolved into consolidated text."},{"primitive":"CANONICALIZE_DEFINITION","doc_ids":["DOC-5ac58e","DOC-0984fb"],"evidence_quote":"The total amount of deposits placed by an UCB with other banks (inter-bank) for all purposes including call money/ notice money, and deposits, if any, placed for availing clearing facility, CSGL facility, currency chest facility, remittance facility and non-fund based facilities like Bank Guarantee (BG), Letter of Credit (LC), etc shall not exceed 20% of its total deposit liabilities as on March 31 of the previous year.","rationale":"A single canonical definition of the prudential inter-bank (gross) exposure limit."},{"primitive":"RESOLVE_CROSS_REFERENCE","doc_ids":["DOC-0984fb","DOC-5ac58e"],"evidence_quote":"Please refer to our circular No. UBD. (PCB). DOC-0984fb dated January 30, 2009 on the captioned subject. The prudential interbank (gross) exposure limit and inter-bank counter party limit for placing deposits with other banks by UCBs for all purposes including for availing clearing facility was prescribed.","rationale":"Cross-reference to the 2009 circular should be resolved into the consolidated limits text."},{"primitive":"ELEVATE_GENERAL_RULE","doc_ids":["DOC-0984fb"],"evidence_quote":"UCBs were advised to formulate a policy taking into account their funds position, liquidity and other needs for placement of deposits with other banks, the cost of funds, expected rate of return and interest margin on such deposits, the counter party risk, etc. and place it before their Board of Directors.","rationale":"Recurring board-policy instruction lifted into a general part."},{"primitive":"RELATE_OBLIGATION","doc_ids":["DOC-63e858","DOC-accde4"],"evidence_quote":"The interbank exposures arising from deposits placed by UCBs with a UCB under AID and their non-performing exposures arising from discounted bills drawn under LCs issued by a UCB under AID","rationale":"Parallel provisioning obligations on interbank exposure kept distinct - the general AID provisioning and the scheme-specific case."},{"primitive":"RESOLVE_CROSS_REFERENCE","doc_ids":["DOC-accde4","DOC-63e858"],"evidence_quote":"In terms of circular DOR.(PCB).DOC-accde4 dated April 20, 2020 , Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks (UCBs) were advised that the interbank exposures arising from deposits placed by UCBs with a UCB under All-inclusive Directions (AID) and their non-performing exposures arising from discounted bills drawn under LCs issued by a UCB under AID shall be fully provided within five years at the rate of 20 per cent annually.","rationale":"Cross-reference to the April 20, 2020 circular resolved into consolidated text."}]}
